title: Among the top 10 departments with the highest variance in total units of co
question: Among the top 10 departments with the highest variance in total units of courses offered (considering only courses with total units greater than 0, departments that are degree granting, and excluding the Mathematics department), display each department's name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, and the course with the highest total units in that department along with its subject code and total units. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    c.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    c.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    c.TOTAL_UNITS,
    c.SUBJECT_ID,
    c.SUBJECT_CODE
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
  JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  WHERE c.TOTAL_UNITS > 0
    AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
    AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics'
),
dept_stats AS (
  SELECT
    DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units,
    STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units
  FROM base
  GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME
),
top10 AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM dept_stats
  ORDER BY variance_total_units DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
top_course AS (
  SELECT
    b.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    b.SUBJECT_ID,
    b.SUBJECT_CODE,
    b.TOTAL_UNITS,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY b.DEPARTMENT_CODE
      ORDER BY b.TOTAL_UNITS DESC, b.SUBJECT_ID
    ) AS rn
  FROM base b
)
SELECT
  t10.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  t10.variance_total_units,
  t10.stddev_total_units,
  tc.SUBJECT_ID,
  tc.SUBJECT_CODE,
  tc.TOTAL_UNITS
FROM top10 t10
JOIN top_course tc
  ON t10.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tc.DEPARTMENT_CODE
 AND tc.rn = 1
ORDER BY t10.variance_total_units DESC

JOIN (SELECT AVG(enrolled_students_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte1) AS avg_stats), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE), admin_stats AS (SELECT inner_cte2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.coefficient_of_variation, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, inner_cte2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON inner_cte2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT vs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, vs.enrolled_students_variance, vs.enrolled_students_stddev, vs.variance_category, ast.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ast.coefficient_of_variation, ast.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM variance_stats AS vs JOIN admin_stats AS ast ON vs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ast.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY vs.enrolled_students_variance DESC

WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, lrmd.TERM_CODE, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM `LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR` AS lci JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT, lrmd.TERM_CODE) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, term, dept_sort) = term THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term, dept, catalog_key_variance, term_sort FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT AS dept, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM (SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, lrmd.TERM_CODE, lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY FROM `LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR` AS lci JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') AS base GROUP BY TERM_CODE, DEPARTMENT WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), DepartmentsWithHighVariance AS (SELECT DISTINCT dept FROM Subquery1 WHERE NOT catalog_key_variance IS NULL) SELECT s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.avg_total_units, s2.stddev_total_units FROM Subquery2 AS s2 WHERE s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN (SELECT dept FROM DepartmentsWithHighVariance) ORDER BY WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON at.TERM_CODE = c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION), cte1 AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_variance, icte.total_units_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte2 AS icte LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cte1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cte1.num_subjects, cte1.TERM_START_DATE, cte1.TERM_END_DATE, cte2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte2.avg_total_units, cte2.total_units_variance, cte2.total_units_stddev, cte2.SCHOOL_NAME, cte2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY cte1.num_subjects DESC, cte2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte_math AS (SELECT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS admin_dept_dense_rank FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'), avg_cip_math AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE AS FLOAT)) AS avg_cip FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'), math_courses_filtered AS (SELECT i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.admin_dept_dense_rank FROM inner_cte_math AS i CROSS JOIN avg_cip_math AS a WHERE i.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > a.avg_cip), inner_cte_units AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), units_stats AS (SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.total_units_stddev, (inner_cte.avg_total_units - overall.avg_all_departments) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte_units AS inner_cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(avg_total_units) AS avg_all_departments FROM (SELECT AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_avgs) AS overall) SELECT mcf.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, mcf.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mcf.SCHOOL_NAME, mcf.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, mcf.admin_dept_dense_rank, us.avg_total_units, us.total_units_variance, us.total_units_stddev, us.deviation_from_overall_avg FROM math_courses_filtered AS mcf JOIN units_stats AS us ON mcf.DEPARTMENT_NAME = us.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY mcf.admin_dept_dense_rank, us.total_units_variance DESC

= o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT d.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND NOT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('ADMISSIONS') AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) > 5), cte2 AS (SELECT inner_cte2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte2.area_stddev, o2.DLC_NAME, inner_cte2.DLC_KEY FROM WITH dept_units_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING') SELECT icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(icte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(icte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(icte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, dept_course_counts.Total_Courses FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN (SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Total_Courses FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_course_counts ON icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_course_counts.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dept_course_counts.Total_Courses), math_course_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.SUBJECT_CODE, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS, scd.COURSE, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND NOT ccc.total_units IS NULL AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.COURSE AS course_number, i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.TOTAL_UNITS, dept_stats.avg_total_units, dept_stats.min_total_units, dept_stats.max_total_units, (i.TOTAL_UNITS -
